messages.content: Write an announcement telling customers that a service is moving to a new platform next quarter. Around 250 words.

Here's a draft. I've left the specifics in brackets since I don't know which service or platform you mean — swap those in and the rest should hold.

---

**Subject: [Service] moves to [New Platform] in [Quarter]**

Hi [Name],

We're moving [Service] to [New Platform] during [Quarter]. Your account, your history, and your saved settings come with it. You don't need to do anything to prepare.

The short version of why: [Old Platform] has taken us as far as it can. It struggles under the load you've been putting on it, and adding [capability customers keep asking for] on top of it would mean building around its limits rather than fixing them. [New Platform] gives us room to do the second thing.

Here's the schedule as it stands:

[Date] — we'll email you a personal migration window, at least two weeks ahead of your move.
[Date] — migrations begin, in batches.
[Date] — [Old Platform] goes read-only. Nothing is deleted; you'll still be able to export.

Expect about [30 minutes] of downtime inside your window. We'll run migrations outside business hours in your timezone wherever we can.

A few things will change. [Specific change 1], and [specific change 2]. [Integration or feature] works differently after the move — the details are in [link]. If you rely on [API or export], read that page before your window comes up.

If the timing is bad for you, reply and tell us. We can shift your window, and we'd rather move you late than move you badly.

Questions go to [email] or [support channel]. We'll keep [status page] current through the whole thing.

[Name]
[Title]
Rewrite the text above. Keep the same length and the same purpose. Return only the rewritten text.
